data.head: ## The CLI's trust walk, read from the 2.1.325 bundle (`~/.local/share/mise/installs/claude/2.1.325/claude`, no start)

body: Read by `/usr/bin/grep -a -o -E` over the installed file; quoted verbatim, minified names as the bundle spells them.

- **The dialog decision:** `function A(){if(Wet())return"skip";return Qs()&&!gpt()?"trusted":"ask"}` — and the
  startup step `if(I=Qs(),I&&!gpt())return null;` before `TrustDialog`.

- **`Qs` → `SL`:** `function SL(){if(i.CLAUDE_CODE_SANDBOXED)return!0;if(sGe())return!0;let
  e=yd(),n=f0e();if(e.projects?.[n]?.hasTrustDialogAccepted)return!0;return bS(e,Te())!==null}` — the exact key
  `f0e()` = `JR(cwd)` (the git root) else `rX(cn(yt(cwd)))`; `cn` is the identity on this build (`function
  cn(t){return t}`), `Te()` is the session's `originalCwd`, set from the start cwd (no `process.env.PWD` read found).

- **The ancestor walk `bS` → `SS`:** `function bS(e,n){let r=cn(yt(n)),s=M2o(r);if(s?.rootOnly){…root's record
  only…}return SS(e,r,s!==null?rX(yt(s.root)):null)}` and `function SS(e,n,r){let s=rX(n);while(!0){if(!(r===null||
  s===r||s.startsWith(r.endsWith("/")?r:r+"/")))return null;if(e.projects?.[s]?.hasTrustDialogAccepted)return
  s;if(s===r)return null;let y=rX(yt(s,".."));if(y===s)return null;s=y}}`.
  **Outside a repository (`r === null`) the walk climbs to `/`: a trusted parent trusts every subfolder.** Inside one
  it stops at the git root.

- **`rootOnly` is dead on this build:** `M2o` takes `rootOnly:!0` only from `Hzo`, whose `BF` is `function
  BF(e,{uncached:n=!1}={}){return null}` and `Fr` `function Fr(e,{uncached:n=!1}={}){return!1}` — `Hzo` returns `null`
  always; `M2o` falls to `gf(n)` (the git root) or `null`. The «unmeasured `rootOnly` branch» is closed for 2.1.325.

- **The override `gpt()`:** `function gpt(e){if(wDo())return!1;if(zfn())return!0;…return(e??q7t()).some(…)}` with
  `wDo()` true when the exact keys are trusted (`return $h()` last; `$h` = every `pp()` folder's exact `due(j2(…))`):
  only a folder trusted by an ANCESTOR alone and holding project or local settings to gate (`Ino()` — settings with
  `extraKnownMarketplaces`; `q7t` adds `.mcp.json` when project MCP servers exist) still gets the dialog. Verify's
  run dirs hold none of these.

- **What the CLI itself writes on accept:** `function ES(e){return(n)=>{…{...n,projects:{...n.projects,[e]:{...n.projects
  ?.[e]??ETe,hasTrustDialogAccepted:!0}}}}}` with `ETe` the 7 defaults (`allowedTools`, `mcpContextUris`, `mcpServers`,
  `enabledMcpjsonServers`, `disabledMcpjsonServers`, `hasTrustDialogAccepted:!1`,
  `hasClaudeMdExternalIncludesApproved`, `hasClaudeMdExternalIncludesWarningShown`) at `fD(cwd)` = `j2` = git root else
  cwd. Every read above tests `hasTrustDialogAccepted` alone; no other field or top-level key is read before trust.

body:
- **What the CLI itself writes on accept:** `function ES(e){return(n)=>{…{...n,projects:{...n.projects,[e]:{...n.projects
  ?.[e]??ETe,hasTrustDialogAccepted:!0}}}}}` with `ETe` the 7 defaults (`allowedTools`, `mcpContextUris`, `mcpServers`,
  `enabledMcpjsonServers`, `disabledMcpjsonServers`, `hasTrustDialogAccepted:!1`,
  `hasClaudeMdExternalIncludesApproved`, `hasClaudeMdExternalIncludesWarningShown`) at `fD(cwd)` = `j2` = git root else
  cwd. Every read above tests `hasTrustDialogAccepted` alone; no other field or top-level key is read before trust.

- **The override `gpt()`:** `function gpt(e){if(wDo())return!1;if(zfn())return!0;…return(e??q7t()).some(…)}` with
  `wDo()` true when the exact keys are trusted (`return $h()` last; `$h` = every `pp()` folder's exact `due(j2(…))`):
  only a folder trusted by an ANCESTOR alone and holding project or local settings to gate (`Ino()` — settings with
  `extraKnownMarketplaces`; `q7t` adds `.mcp.json` when project MCP servers exist) still gets the dialog. Verify's
  run dirs hold none of these.

- **`rootOnly` is dead on this build:** `M2o` takes `rootOnly:!0` only from `Hzo`, whose `BF` is `function
  BF(e,{uncached:n=!1}={}){return null}` and `Fr` `function Fr(e,{uncached:n=!1}={}){return!1}` — `Hzo` returns `null`
  always; `M2o` falls to `gf(n)` (the git root) or `null`. The «unmeasured `rootOnly` branch» is closed for 2.1.325.

- **The ancestor walk `bS` → `SS`:** `function bS(e,n){let r=cn(yt(n)),s=M2o(r);if(s?.rootOnly){…root's record
  only…}return SS(e,r,s!==null?rX(yt(s.root)):null)}` and `function SS(e,n,r){let s=rX(n);while(!0){if(!(r===null||
  s===r||s.startsWith(r.endsWith("/")?r:r+"/")))return null;if(e.projects?.[s]?.hasTrustDialogAccepted)return
  s;if(s===r)return null;let y=rX(yt(s,".."));if(y===s)return null;s=y}}`.
  **Outside a repository (`r === null`) the walk climbs to `/`: a trusted parent trusts every subfolder.** Inside one
  it stops at the git root.

- **`Qs` → `SL`:** `function SL(){if(i.CLAUDE_CODE_SANDBOXED)return!0;if(sGe())return!0;let
  e=yd(),n=f0e();if(e.projects?.[n]?.hasTrustDialogAccepted)return!0;return bS(e,Te())!==null}` — the exact key
  `f0e()` = `JR(cwd)` (the git root) else `rX(cn(yt(cwd)))`; `cn` is the identity on this build (`function
  cn(t){return t}`), `Te()` is the session's `originalCwd`, set from the start cwd (no `process.env.PWD` read found).

- **The dialog decision:** `function A(){if(Wet())return"skip";return Qs()&&!gpt()?"trusted":"ask"}` — and the
  startup step `if(I=Qs(),I&&!gpt())return null;` before `TrustDialog`.
Read by `/usr/bin/grep -a -o -E` over the installed file; quoted verbatim, minified names as the bundle spells them.

- `~/.viola/ledger/stamps.json` — read for row words only (no path, key or value kept): the live home's `2.1.325` entry
  holds 21 rows, every one `pass` (`python3` json read, `len(rows)` = 21): it predates `local-command-echo` and

- `tests/support/verify.rs` (403–475, 600–640) — every test verify under a test-owned `HOME`, a `--record` start keeping

- `crates/viola-e2e/src/rig/mod.rs` (230–320, 750–810) — the `V` arm seeds `seed_config(true)`, runs verify wrapped

   `hasTrustDialogAccepted`, the file's other top-level keys the CLI may need before it trusts anything — and say
   what differs. If a difference explains Run F, say so as a hypothesis with what would falsify it;
   (ii) the unread part of the CLI's trust walk: `Hzo` past its first statement and `gf`, on the 2.1.325 bundle —
   outside a repository, does a trusted parent make a subfolder trusted? Quote what decides it;

   closed word with the existing signatures (`trust` · `imports` · `box` · `none`), in the stamp's `measured`,
   printed by the rig's `V` arm before teardown. No screen text kept.
